Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
salem expounded:

> Also, Blood To Water says 'only usable at close range, before strike
> resolution.'
> My predator (acting methuselah) played it just after I chose my
> strike. which was cheeky, but as far as i could see was perfectly
> legal (just from card text).
> Is there a ruling on that, or is Blood to Water better than i thought?
> :)

I'm pretty sure that's right -certainly that's how I've been playing it;
it would say 'before strikes are declared' or something otherwise. Just
like you can wait for strikes before you pull out your Wolf Claws.

In fact it would be better pre-strike because that would
(potentially) prevent your opponent from playing a strike card with a
cost -spending it is unlikely to take them down to 5 blood: more likely
they are already there or too full for it to matter.

NB it's only playable in second round and is not a strike: Shotgun
Ritual won't help sadly. It also costs 2 blood. AND it's not damage so
youcan't use Taste of Vitae on it.

Wind Dance, Telepathic tracking, Walk of Flame, Blood to Water (x2 if
necessary) would be pretty powerful but that's a 4-card combo so hardly
overpowered. You'd probably want a Maneuver in there to avoid being
grappled too...
